messages:
customer-ops:ACME: We're seeing 403s from KMS unwraps since last night's deploy. Audit logs for keystore/unseal ops are missing and billing shows a huge spike for unwrap ops. This is blocking our compliance audit. Example request id: req-1a2b3c. Need ETA on patch or rollback and repro steps. @emma

emma (support): Sorry to hear that — opening a P0 ticket and escalating. Can you paste a minimal failing request and any stderr from the client? Also can you confirm region and affected tenant id?

customer-ops:ACME: tenant=acme-prod, region=us-east-1. Here's a minimal curl that fails:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/keystore/unwrap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: req-1a2b3c" \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```
Response: 403 {"error":"unwrap_failed","code":"KMS_UNAUTHORIZED"}

maria (sre-oncall): @emma got it. I'm looking at infra metrics — there's a spike in 5xx/403s for the keystore service starting 2023-11-02 02:12 UTC (post-deploy). Audit ingestion pipeline also shows gaps for that time.

raj (eng-security): Heads up — we pushed a crypto dependency at that deploy (libwrap 2.4.1 -> 2.5.0) which had a breaking change in KEK negotiation. We're seeing header negotiation mismatch causing unwrap to reject with 403 instead of nicer error. Possible CVE surface; I'll audit but treat as urgent.

joel (infra): Rolling back the whole deploy is heavy but we can toggle the keystore feature-flag to legacy unwrap path. Command: `rbctl feature keystore.use_legacy_unwrap --set=true --env=prod --scope=acme-prod` — I'll stand by to run if eng-security approves.

devbot: deploy-redwood/keystore-service v2023.11.02 completed by @joel at 2023-11-02T02:05:12Z

emma (support): @customer-ops:ACME can you share a short sample of the service-side logs around req-1a2b3c (redact tokens)? Also: did you rotate any keys or change KMS config on your side?

customer-ops:ACME: attaching sanitized logs: `keystore: unwrap failed; nego_version=2; client_kek=sha1:xx; error=unauthorized`. We didn't rotate anything. We started the audit run at 02:15 UTC and noticed missing entries in audit-stream by 02:20. Billing spike correlates to many client retries.

raj (eng-security): Repro steps we used internally:
```
# failing path
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Kek-Negotiate: v2.5" \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}' \
  https://keystore.internal/unwrap
# succeeds if header forced to legacy
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Kek-Negotiate: legacy" \
  https://keystore.internal/unwrap
```
So a short-term mitigation is to accept `X-Kek-Negotiate: legacy` or enable the legacy unwrap codepath. This avoids data movement.

lisa (legal): If audit logs are missing for customer production decrypts that is a compliance issue. We need scope: which records are missing and whether they can be reconstructed. Please preserve all logs and forward sanitized copies.

anna (product): Billing spike: tagging @billingbot to run a usage delta for acme-prod between 02:00-03:00 UTC. We need to quantify customer exposure and refund risk.

billingbot: Scheduled usage-delta report for tenant=acme-prod window=2023-11-02T02:00Z..2023-11-02T03:00Z. ETA 15m.

maria (sre-oncall): For immediate action I recommend: 1) Toggle `keystore.use_legacy_unwrap` for acme-prod (fastest). 2) Backfill audit events from service buffer (we have 48h buffered events). 3) Block reactive autoscaling that causes repeated retries. I'll coordinate the toggle with infra.

joel (infra): Ready to toggle. Will execute after `eng-security` thumbs-up. Command to rollback full deploy is `rbctl rollback deploy/keystore-service --to v2023.10.21` but that will affect other customers.

raj (eng-security): Thumbs-up for the flag toggle as mitigation. Work on a proper hotfix for libwrap ASAP — initial analysis suggests a non-backwards-compatible negotiation change in 2.5.0; could be a CVE if it allows auth bypass in other modes. I'll propose patch v2.5.1 to restore strictness and add negotiation compatibility. Estimating hotfix in 4 hours; flag toggle is immediate.

emma (support): Communicating to customer: we'll enable legacy unwrap for your tenant now, backfill missing audit events, and follow up with a hotfix timeline. ETA for flag toggle: 10-15m. ETA for hotfix: ~4h. Will open a dedicated support ticket (P0) with these timelines.

customer-ops:ACME: Please confirm before toggling. Legacy path is acceptable for now but want written confirmation we'll not lose audit entries and want timeline for permanent fix. Also want SLA credit if billing spike results in overage.

maria (sre-oncall): Confirmed — we will attempt audit backfill first, then toggle. Backfill success rate is high; we'll provide scope list. If backfill fails for any events we'll note that and coordinate with legal.

raj (eng-security): I'll patch and run canary tests in staging; if stable we'll push hotfix to prod with a short maintenance window. If rollback becomes necessary it's possible within 30m but it's disruptive.

emma (support): Ticket created: P0-2345. Linking this thread. I'll update customer every 15m until resolved. :lock:

customer-ops:ACME: Thanks. Please include a postmortem and CVE disclosure plan if one is needed. We're starting our audit report now and will pause until you confirm backfill results.

maria (sre-oncall): Noted. I'll DM @lisa with any legal-required notifications. Starting backfill now, will update in ~12m.

-- end of thread --
